mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_run WHERE run_id = CAST(#{runId} AS uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_inspection_run(run_id, agent_id, server_id, policy_id, policy_version, plan_id, run_type, started_at, finished_at, overall_status, item_count, warn_count, critical_count, error_count, source_ip) VALUES(CAST(#{runId} AS uuid), CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)NULL, #{serverId}, #{policyId}, #{policyVersion}, #{planId}, #{runType}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{overallStatus}, #{itemCount}, #{warnCount}, #{criticalCount}, #{errorCount}, #{sourceIp})

INSERT INTO pmc_inspection_result_item(run_id, category, item_code, item_name, value, unit, status, source, input_user, threshold_warn, threshold_critical, raw_text, error_text, collected_at) VALUES(CAST(#{runId} AS uuid), #{category}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{value}, #{unit}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{source},'AUTO'), #{inputUser}, #{thresholdWarn}, #{thresholdCritical}, #{rawText}, #{errorText}, #{collectedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, s.hostname FROM pmc_inspection_run r LEFT JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id=r.server_id WHERE r.server_id = #{serverId} ORDER BY r.received_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT r.*, s.hostname, s.dept_code, s.service_name, s.os_type FROM pmc_inspection_run r LEFT JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id=r.server_id WHERE r.run_id = CAST(#{runId} AS uuid)
SELECT * FROM pmc_inspection_result_item WHERE run_id = CAST(#{runId} AS uuid) ORDER BY category, item_code
SELECT category, status, count(*) AS cnt FROM pmc_inspection_result_item ri JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id=ri.run_id WHERE r.received_at >= now() - interval '7 day' GROUP BY category, status
